BetterTube is a privacy-friendly YouTube client for Android, forked from [LibreTube](https://github.com/libre-tube/LibreTube). Its audio-only mode really saves data, and the whole app has been redesigned to feel calm, modern and fast.

## Install

Download **`BetterTube-v0.3.0.apk`** below and open it on your phone. Android may ask you to allow installs from your browser or file manager. BetterTube installs next to the official LibreTube app.

> [!NOTE]
> **Already on v0.2.x?** This installs as an update and keeps your data.
>
> **Coming from a v0.1.x preview?** Those were a separate test app, so move over once: in the old BetterTube, Settings → Backup and restore → **Backup**; install this version; in the new BetterTube, **Restore** the backup; then uninstall the old one.

## What's new in 0.3

**Swipe between tabs.** Home, Subscriptions, Library and your other tabs now sit side by side: swipe sideways and the next tab slides in under your finger, already loaded, and snaps into place. Tapping the dock glides there too.

**Vivid accent colours.** Seven new punchy accents: Electric blue, Neon violet, Hot pink, Sunset orange, Lime, Aqua and Crimson (Settings → Appearance → Accent colour). They're tuned to stay readable in both light and dark mode.

**A smoother audio player.**
- Swiping down shrinks the artwork straight into the mini player, just like the video does.
- The play button and progress bar fade gently into each new video's colours (or keep your accent colour if you turn that off in Settings → Appearance; the change applies right away).
- Opening and closing the player is quicker.

**Fixes**
- Long video descriptions in the audio player no longer spill over the artwork.
- Changing the app icon works again.

## Highlights

**Audio-only that really saves data.** Switching to audio mid-video stops video downloads for real (in LibreTube, video keeps downloading in the background). A small label in the player shows how much data the video has used. BetterTube remembers audio mode for the next videos you open.

**Designed to feel calm and fast.**
- Its own typeface, a floating dock, and a darker, richer look throughout.
- The audio player takes its colours from each video's artwork.
- Tabs keep their content when you switch back, and tapping a thumbnail fades straight into the video.

**Small things that add up.**
- One-tap **Watch later**.
- Playback errors retry by themselves from where you were.
- Video ages are short (7h, 3d).
- Links shared from the YouTube app open even while BetterTube is already open.

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/capheproject/BetterTube#changelog) for everything since the first preview.

BetterTube is built on LibreTube by Bnyro and the LibreTube contributors and, like LibreTube, is licensed under the GPL-3.0.
